summary: When something goes wrong, your code should fail loudly and clearly. You raise a specific error, catch only that one, and write log messages at the right level (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR) instead of print. Swallowing an error hides the real problem and costs you later.
goal: Make a failed lookup leave a clear log line instead of silence.

items.text: Answer the two warm-up questions from memory, then guess the hook
Step 1: run errors_demo.py and match the output
Step 2: set the level to DEBUG, predict the new lines, then run it
Step 3: swallow the error with except Exception: pass and read the confusing result
Step 4: write safe_top_k and test it with 5, abc and 99
Play the Log Detective game to the end and see your score
